questions.stem: A 22-year-old man develops the insidious onset of low back pain improved with exercise and worsened by rest. There is no history of diarrhea, conjunctivitis, urethritis, rash, or nail changes. On examination, the patient has loss of mobility with respect to lumbar flexion and extension. He has a kyphotic posture. Which test or group of tests would be most supportive of suspected diagnosis?
questions.stemHtml: A 22-year-old man develops the insidious onset of low back pain improved with exercise and worsened by rest. There is no history of diarrhea, conjunctivitis, urethritis, rash, or nail changes. On examination, the patient has loss of mobility with respect to lumbar flexion and extension. He has a kyphotic posture. Which test or group of tests would be most supportive of suspected diagnosis?

options.label: B
options.text: ESR, HLA-B27 and plain X ray of the sacroiliac joints

options.label: C
options.text: Rheumatoid factor, anti-CCP, and C-reactive protein level.
